title: User function body with chained early returns (priority-encoder shape) — pass 20
sourceUrl: internal: Tier 4.3 pass 20 canonicalizer multi-if chain
license: internal regression test, no external reference
problemDescription: Function body is three chained guard-return ifs terminated by a fallback return. Pass 20's canonicalizer folds the chain into flat if/elsif/elsif/else, then TryInlineIfElseAsMux emits a 3-arm MUX cascade. Priority-encoder semantics: y=01 if r0 else y=10 if r1 else y=11 if r2 else y=00.
